messages.author: 293d497b6f45a24a
messages.subject: line plot with overlay
parts:
Dear List,

I want to overlay the average of a given dataset onto a simple line
plot of the same dataset.

Here is a simple example:

#generate some data
estimation <- sample(1:100,8)
#add information on trial
trial <- rep(1:4,2)
#add information on participant
subject<- rep(1:2, each = 4)

#put it together into a data frame
data<-data.frame(estimation,subject,trial)

#plot the estimations in a line plot
g <- ggplot(data, aes(x=trial, y=estimation, group=subject)) +
geom_line()

#up to this point everything is fine as as expected
#now I want to add an overlay line in read displaying the means of
estimation for each trial

g + geom_line(stat="summary", fun.y = "mean", colour = "red")

#the result is that the two lines turn red (instead of staying black)
and the line with the average is missing (I would like to end up with
three lines)

Any advice??

Thanks a lot
Michael

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: line plot with overlay
parts:
hi, try this:

g + geom_line(stat="summary", fun.y = "mean", colour = "red", aes(group=NULL))
